pages.title: Ancient Symbol Game
pages.text: Ancient Symbol is a matching game, reveal the symbol of 2 blocks at a time to find their exact match. When all matches are found, Right-Click the game block again to recieve your reward.

pages.title: Magical Book
pages.text: The Magical Book starts the game by Right-Clicking the Ancient Symbol Interpreter.

pages.title: Book of Translation
pages.text: The Book of Translation is given for succesfully completing the game.
